A grand readable vista, not overloaded with spectators, flags or tiny architectural noise. No foreground people, no visible individual combatants, no text/logo/UI/frame. Narrative fantasy PAINTING with distinct broad brush planes, crafted stone and ocean haze matching Momo/Valazar references, luminous daylight rather than dark mood.
